mathematical_meanings: Left image: The symbol "b" denotes the constant term and vertical intercept of the straight line. Right image: The symbol "b" denotes a length or a variable in the indicated length expression.
Rationales: The left occurrence is b as the standalone term in y = kx + b. The right occurrence is b below the right part of the triangle base. The left placement shows that the symbol denotes the constant term and vertical intercept of the straight line, while the right placement shows that it denotes a length or a variable in the indicated length expression.
